remove.reason: stale sudo authority for a68e7e0969b45e7eb8add18ff2007a305a0156aa preflight and deploy
root deploy wrapper pinned to a68e7e09; the repaired gate runs deploy.sh unprivileged, so no root release runner remains

must_not_change: the deployment account's authorized_keys entry, its key material and its options
docker group membership, socket ownership and the live container

preconditions.check: the forced command in the deployment account's authorized_keys is exactly /usr/local/sbin/backbond-real-agent-demo-ssh-gate
preconditions.on_mismatch: stop; this candidate does not authorize an authorized_keys edit

preconditions.check: sshd's sftp subsystem is one of the shapes the gate accepts
preconditions.on_mismatch: stop and report the exact configured value; the upload leg would fail closed

preconditions.check: /etc/backbond is root-owned and not group or world writable
preconditions.on_mismatch: stop; the authorization helper refuses to consume a grant from a writable directory

preconditions.check: the deployment account can reach docker without sudo, as deploy.sh at d9 requires
preconditions.on_mismatch: stop and report; this candidate does not broaden docker access

preconditions.check: no arm file and no d9 release directory exist before installation

arming.note: Installation MUST NOT create this file. Arming is a separate operator action taken only after BEAAA-23702 returns READY and the Founder decision stands.

rollback: restore /usr/local/sbin/backbond-real-agent-demo-ssh-gate from the root-owned pre-install backup, or remove it to leave the key with no runnable forced command
restore /etc/sudoers.d/backbond-real-agent-demo and /usr/local/sbin/backbond-real-agent-demo-deploy from backup only if a return to the stale a68 posture is explicitly decided
remove /etc/backbond/real-agent-demo-deploy.allow if it exists, which restores the fail-closed state in every case
